headline: Meeting cancelled; the posted notice lists no agenda items.
summary: The regular meeting has been cancelled. The notice lists no business for this session.
plain_text:

CANCELLATION 
NOTICE 
 
 
The regular meeting of the Zoning Board of Adjustment for 
November 24, 2026 has been cancelled. 
 
The next regular meeting of the Zoning Board of Adjustment will be 
held on TUESDAY, DECEMBER 8, 2026 at 6:30pm in the City 
Hall 3rd floor Auditorium, unless otherwise posted. 
 
If you have any questions or concerns, please call or email the 
Planning Department at planningdepartment@nashuanh.gov  
and 589-3090.
